pages.title: Coloring: Mosaic by Symbols
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Coloring: Mosaic by Symbols turns pixel pictures into symbol-guided mosaics. Each color corresponds to a shape, such as a heart, star or flower. Use those symbols to work out which color belongs in each part of the picture, filling the pixels until the painting is complete.

Coins connect the coloring activities to a collection of paintings. Start with the game's initial coins to buy pictures, then collect additional coins that appear while you color by clicking or tapping them. Finished paintings can also be sold for more coins, which you can put toward another set. The currency is used within the game as you build and color your picture collection.

pages.title: Color Clash
pages.creator: Playful Cochon
pages.description:
Color Clash is a turn-based territory puzzle played across a board of colored cells. Start from your corner and choose a color to change your territory. Neighboring cells in that color join your area, allowing you to spread across the board one turn at a time.

You cannot choose either your current color or your opponent's current color. Compare the available choices to see which ones reach useful groups of cells and leave room for another expansion. Once every cell belongs to a player, the larger territory wins. The hosted game includes computer opponents and a local two-player option, both built around choosing colors rather than moving a character.

pages.title: Cow Jam Farm puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description:
Cow Jam Farm puzzle puts a herd of cows into crowded farm paths. Your task is to get every cow out safely by working out which ones can leave and which are still blocked. Click or tap to interact with the herd and begin clearing the jam.

Look at the space around each cow before choosing your next action. Opening one route can help you deal with the animals still waiting behind it. Keep untangling the arrangement until all the cows have escaped the crowded paths.

pages.title: Xytrian Runner
pages.creator: LUCKY TRY
pages.description:
Xytrian Runner puts you in a spaceship on an endless obstacle course. Hold the control to gain height, then release it to let the shuttle descend. The longer you hold, the higher you rise, making altitude changes the main way to get through the gaps.

Click or tap to control the flight while watching the obstacles ahead. You are trying to survive for as long as possible and build a score, rather than reach a fixed finish line. Judge when to climb and when to drop so the next barrier does not cut your run short.

pages.title: Accurate 2D
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description:
Accurate 2D is a shooting game about eliminating the enemies in each level. Press and keep holding to line up your aim, then release to fire. The shot follows your setup, so take a moment to judge the target before letting go.

Clear the enemies to work through the game's levels. The controls combine aiming and firing in one press-and-release action, keeping attention on where you want the shot to go. Adjust that aim for the opponents in front of you as you move from one encounter to the next.

pages.title: Grass Defense
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description:
Grass Defense is a tower-defense game about protecting wilderness from attacking creatures. Build towers, improve their capabilities and manage the resources needed to keep your defenses effective. The enemies arrive in waves, giving you a continuing test of the setup you have created.

As stronger creatures enter the battle, reconsider where your resources will help most. Adding defenses and upgrading existing towers are both parts of preparing for the next attack. Use the left mouse button to interact with the game and develop your strategy across its different environments and levels.

pages.title: Happy Fluffy Cubes
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Happy Fluffy Cubes sends a cube-shaped character flying through courses filled with fire, ice, lasers and rotating saws. Hold the screen and move up or down to guide your Fluffy around the traps. Keeping contact is part of the control scheme, so the flight depends on continuous movement rather than separate jump presses.

Collect coins during the run and spend them on chests. A chest may contain an egg that hatches into another Fluffy, with different appearances and rarities to discover. Your collection grows alongside the obstacle courses, giving you new cube heroes to choose while you work on getting through the hazards.

pages.title: Ocean Pop
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Ocean Pop is an underwater bubble puzzle in which the pieces float, bounce and gather into clusters. Click or tap matching bubbles to pop them and create combinations. Removing a group can start a chain reaction as the remaining bubbles shift around.

The moving pieces make the arrangement change while you play. Watch how the clusters settle before picking another match, and look for a pop that brings more bubbles together. Your task is to clear the floating groups through matching and combos in this physics-based playfield.

pages.title: Vibe Colouring
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Vibe Colouring is a color-by-number game with pictures ranging from memes to landscapes. Choose an image, select a color from the palette at the bottom and tap the areas carrying its number. Filling those marked regions gradually completes the picture.

A magnifier helps you zoom in when a small area is difficult to locate, while hints point toward sections that remain uncolored. You can select different pictures from the library and work through their numbered regions in turn. The game also includes a leaderboard based on how many areas players have colored, connecting the individual pictures to a larger coloring total.

pages.title: Merge Beasts
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description:
Merge Beasts is a creature-merging game where matching animals combine into stronger forms. Drag a beast onto another of the same kind to create the next creature, then keep pairing the results to discover further evolutions.

Collect coins and improve your beasts as the monster city develops. Each new merge adds another creature to work with, so arranging matching pairs is central to growing your collection. Follow the evolution chain from the smaller beasts toward the rarer forms you have yet to uncover.

pages.title: Mahjong Crimes - Puzzle Story
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description:
Mahjong Crimes - Puzzle Story combines tile matching with detective mysteries featuring Hercule Poirot. Join the investigation aboard the Orient Express and clear mahjong layouts to uncover clues and move the case forward. Select pairs of identical available tiles with the mouse or touch controls.

The aim of each puzzle is to remove the entire arrangement. Pay attention to which tiles are uncovered and accessible before choosing a pair, because removing them changes what you can reach next. Boosters help with difficult boards, while tile sets and rewards give you additional things to collect as you progress through the crime story.

pages.title: Transformers Battle For The City
pages.creator: DarkPlay
pages.description:
Transformers Battle For The City is an open-world action game about defending a city from invading robots. Accept story assignments and travel to the fighting, changing between a car and a robot to take on the attackers. The seven story tasks become more demanding as you progress.

Use WASD to move and press T to transform. In car form, Space brakes and the left mouse button fires the machine guns. In robot form, Left Shift runs, while the left, right and middle mouse buttons perform attacks of different strengths. Switching forms changes how you move through the city and the attacks available during a battle.

pages.title: Fillwords: Find All the Words
pages.creator: 7thReactor
pages.description:
Fillwords: Find All the Words gives you a letter grid and a set of hidden words to locate. Connect the letters of a target word horizontally, vertically or diagonally. Words can run backward and overlap, so a letter you have already used may belong to another answer as well.

Use the mouse or touch controls to trace your selections. The themed puzzles vary their word combinations, giving you different grids to search. Check the letters surrounding a likely starting point and follow the possible directions; hints are available when a word remains difficult to find.

pages.title: Crazy 2248 Link - Matching Puzzle Game
pages.creator: CrazyFire
pages.description:
Crazy 2248 Link - Matching Puzzle Game is a number-linking puzzle about combining equal blocks into larger values. Swipe across matching numbers to connect them, working through values such as 1024, 2048 and 4096 on the way toward the infinity block.

Links can follow the horizontal and vertical directions described by the game's controls. Look for numbers that can be brought together, then use the higher block produced by a merge as part of your next combination. The board keeps giving you another arrangement to consider as you build toward the larger values.

pages.title: Extreme Car Driving Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description:
Extreme Car Driving Simulator gives you several ways to put a car through a driving challenge. In Open World mode, find passenger-transport missions out on the roads. Parking mode asks you to place the car in difficult spaces, shifting the task from covering distance to positioning the vehicle carefully.

The game offers four modes in total and additional cars to buy as you continue. Choose a challenge according to the driving task you want to practice, then work toward another vehicle. Passenger trips and demanding parking layouts provide different reasons to pay attention to both your route and your approach to the destination.

pages.title: Clean Road 3D
pages.creator: CHETRUSCA SOFTWORKS S.R.L
pages.description:
Clean Road 3D puts you in a snow-clearing vehicle with townspeople waiting to leave their homes. Open a safe route through the snow and obstacles so their cars can reach the cleared road. The level succeeds when everyone gets through; an accident involving a resident ends the attempt.

Your vehicle moves forward automatically. Press A to steer left or D to steer right as you choose the route to clear. Watch the traffic you are helping as well as the space directly ahead, because your work needs to leave a path the other cars can use safely.

pages.title: Jelly Match 4
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Jelly Match 4 combines placing block sets with making color matches. Take a set from the panel on the left and fit it onto the board, aiming to form a horizontal or vertical line of four similar blocks. Clicking a set rotates it before placement.

You have three available sets to account for. If any of them can no longer fit on the board, the game ends, so check the shapes you still need to place before filling a useful space. Use the mouse or touchpad to arrange the pieces and make room through matches.

pages.title: Bottle Flip
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description:
Bottle Flip asks you to carry a plastic bottle across a room by flipping it from one object to another. Shelves, chairs, tables and sofas become places to land. Judge the distance to the next surface before sending the bottle into the air.

Click and hold to set the jump's power, then release to make the leap. Different gaps call for a different amount of force, so adjust each attempt to the furniture in front of you. The challenge is controlling the bottle's flight well enough to keep progressing across the objects.

pages.title: Nonogram Picture Cross Puzzle Game
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Nonogram Picture Cross Puzzle Game is a grid puzzle in which number clues tell you where to fill cells. Compare the clues with the available spaces and mark the correct locations to work out the picture. The game offers three difficulty choices.

Tap the board to make your selections as you solve the arrangement. Each filled section needs to agree with the number information, so consider how a choice affects the rest of the grid before committing to another area. Completing the correct pattern resolves the puzzle.

pages.title: Spooky Escape
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Spooky Escape puts you in the role of a spooky creature trying to get away from pursuers. Their infrared scans reveal the areas where you are at risk of being detected. Escape quickly while paying attention to where those scans reach.

Outside the scanned areas, you can attack the people chasing you. That gives you a choice between continuing the escape and using an opening to strike back. Tap to play and judge the scanning zones before moving toward a pursuer, keeping the creature out of sight while looking for a safe opportunity.

pages.title: Math Signs Game
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description:
Math Signs Game challenges you to choose the mathematical sign that makes an operation correct. Work through questions involving addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, selecting an answer with the mouse or touch buttons. Speed matters as you try to improve your high score.

Read the numbers before choosing between the signs, then move on to the next calculation. The task tests recognizing the right operation as well as evaluating the expression. Use each attempt to see how many questions you can answer quickly and accurately.

pages.title: Bike Stunt Racing Game 2021
pages.creator: WebAvari
pages.description:
Bike Stunt Racing Game 2021 puts a motorcycle on difficult stunt tracks with jumps and rough sections to negotiate. Ride through the course, handle the approaches to the obstacles and keep the bike moving as you work through the racing challenge.

W moves forward, S moves backward, and A and D turn left and right. The game also provides on-screen buttons for touch play. Judge the route ahead before approaching a stunt, especially when a jump leads straight into another section that needs careful control.

pages.title: Wings Rush Forces
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Wings Rush Forces is a fast platform adventure starring a blue bird on a mission to save the world. Travel through areas with wild animals, hostile robots and dangerous water, collecting rings while keeping the character away from hazards.

Use A and D or the Left and Right arrows to move, and W or Up to jump. On-screen buttons provide touch controls. Watch the next stretch of platforms before leaping, then use movement and jumps together to get past enemies and continue through the course.

pages.title: Grass Cut Master
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description:
Grass Cut Master gives you a vehicle and a limited amount of time to mow the grass on each platform. Drive across the overgrown areas and clear them before the countdown runs out. Completing the work earns income that can improve your equipment.

Upgrade the vehicle's capacity, blade length and blade speed to make later mowing jobs more efficient. Those improvements affect how much work you can cover and how quickly you can do it. Use WASD, the arrow keys or the mouse to steer as you plan a route around the grass still waiting to be cut.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Master
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Tic Tac Toe Master lets you take turns placing marks against a computer opponent or a friend. Use the familiar 3-by-3 board or choose an expanded grid, with custom sizes ranging from 5-by-5 to 8-by-8. Work toward a winning line while watching the spaces your opponent needs.

Click or tap a space to make your move. A larger board gives you more positions to consider, while the traditional grid keeps the contest compact. Look for your own opportunities without leaving an immediate route open for the other player.

pages.title: Car Eats Car: Volcanic Adventure
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description:
Car Eats Car: Volcanic Adventure mixes driving with battles against hostile cars and police. Your car friends have been imprisoned, and you race and fight to free them. Upgrade your vehicle, create cars through the incubator and prepare for boss encounters along the way.

Use W for the accelerator, S for braking and A or D to balance the car. X activates turbo and Space drops bombs; the arrow keys also provide driving and balance controls. Choose when to use speed to get past a rival and when to attack, keeping the car under control through the volcanic adventure.

pages.title: Canoniac Launcher 2
pages.creator: Garbuz Studio
pages.description:
Canoniac Launcher 2 sends Jimmy the robot flying across an alien planet. Aim the launcher and try to carry him as far as possible, then use upgrades to develop the equipment behind your next attempt. Distance is the central goal of each launch.

Move the mouse to aim, hold the left button to build power and release it to fire. Clicking also lets you shoot during play. Judge the launch angle and force together, then try another setup as you work toward a longer flight through the planet's alien surroundings.

pages.title: Jump Ball Adventures
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description:
Jump Ball Adventures sends a ball through levels filled with obstacles. Move left and right to avoid the hazards and collect stars along the route. The stars you earn can be exchanged for different balls, giving you more appearances to use on later stages.

Use the arrow keys to play or tap the screen to jump. Watch the next opening while you move, adjusting the ball's position to pass the obstacles ahead. Each level provides another course to clear and another chance to gather stars for your collection.

pages.title: Run Rabbit Run
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description:
Run Rabbit Run follows a blue rabbit trying to reach the guard waiting at the end of each level. Travel through the course, deal with enemies and monsters, and continue toward the rendezvous that advances the adventure.

Use WASD to control the rabbit, or play with the touch controls. A double jump gives you another movement option while crossing the level. Judge the next stretch before taking off, using that extra jump when the route calls for more height or distance on the way to the guard.

pages.title: Time Witch
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description:
Time Witch is a puzzle platformer built around a witch's ability to distort time. Move through each area and use that power to get past enemies and obstacles. Progress depends on considering the timing of the scene as well as the route across it.

Use A and D or the arrow keys to move, W or Up to jump, and V to activate the time-distortion power. Touch controls are also available. Look at what is moving before using the ability, then choose the moment that lets the witch continue through the puzzle.

pages.title: Cubic Wall
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Cubic Wall is a color-matching timing game. Balls fall from above toward a wall made of differently colored bricks, and your task is to catch each ball with a brick of the same color. Tap the screen to move the wall into position.

Watch both the falling ball and the wall's movement before acting. The right color needs to be in the right place when the ball arrives, so timing the movement matters as much as recognizing the match. Keep lining up the colored sections for the balls that follow.

pages.title: Queen Bee
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Queen Bee is a collecting runner where the items you pick up determine your progress toward a fashionable finish. Drag to guide the character along the route, gathering the items marked with green rings and avoiding those marked in red.

The rings give you a quick way to distinguish the pickups you want from the ones you should leave alone. Watch the choices ahead and adjust your path before reaching them, keeping your collection focused on the green-marked items as you continue down the street.

pages.title: Annihilate
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description:
Annihilate is a puzzle game about bringing pairs of same-colored atoms together. Swipe or use the arrow keys to move every dynamic object in the chosen direction. When matching atoms meet, they annihilate, clearing that pair from the puzzle.

Each level limits the number of moves, and obstacles such as lasers, black holes and uranium-235 complicate the route. Since a single input moves several objects, consider the whole arrangement before committing to a direction. Work out how to bring the pairs together without using up the moves you need for the remaining atoms.

pages.title: Crowd Farm
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Crowd Farm puts you in charge of a growing group of farm animals. Drag to lead the flock around the farm, collect more followers and use your group's larger numbers to take over smaller animal groups.

The size of your crowd shapes which groups you can challenge. Look for opportunities to grow before approaching another cluster of animals, then keep the flock moving through the farm. Building up the group and using that numerical advantage are the central parts of the game.

pages.title: Battboy Adventure
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Battboy Adventure sends a costumed hero through eight increasingly difficult platforming levels. Avoid the thorns, get past the killer clowns and collect stars as you work toward the end of each stage. Gathering every star is required for full completion.

Play with the keyboard or a joystick on a computer, or use the on-screen touch buttons. Pay attention to the enemies and hazards around a collectible before going after it, particularly when the next platform leaves little room to land. Clearing the route and collecting its stars give you two goals to consider together.

pages.title: Connect A Dot
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Connect A Dot reveals sea animals through numbered outlines. Begin with the smallest number and connect the dots in ascending order, following the sequence until the outline forms a complete closed picture.

Use the mouse or your finger to draw the connections without breaking the sequence. Check which number comes next before moving across the picture, then continue around the remaining points. The finished animal emerges from the line you have drawn through the full set of dots.

pages.title: Tank Wars
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description:
Tank Wars is an arcade tank game in which destroying enemy armor is only part of the job: you must also protect your base. If the base is destroyed, the mission fails. Fight alone or join a friend for a two-player battle, and use the terrain and battlefield bonuses to help survive the attack.

In solo play, move with WASD or the arrow keys and shoot with Space. With two players, the first uses WASD and Space, while the second uses the arrow keys and Num 0. The game also includes a battlefield editor, giving you a way to create layouts beyond the supplied battles.

pages.title: American Trucks Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
American Trucks Memory asks you to remember truck pictures and uncover their matching partners. Tap the cards to inspect them, then select two showing the same image. Match the full set before the level's timer runs out.

Each picture you reveal gives you information for a later pair, even when the current choices do not match. Keep track of the truck designs and their positions as you clear the board. Completing the pairs in time lets you continue through the memory challenges.

pages.title: Super Color Lines
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description:
Super Color Lines is a grid puzzle about arranging five pieces of the same color into a line. Select a colored square, then choose the place you want it to move. Completing the five-piece line removes those pieces and awards points.

Use the mouse or tap controls to organize the board around the colors already present. Look for a line you can develop with the pieces available, and consider where a moved square will leave space for the next arrangement. Repeatedly clearing those lines is how you build your score.

pages.title: Color Mill
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description:
Color Mill is a matching game about catching colored bags of flour with the corresponding color on a mill. Tap to control the play and line up the right match as the bags arrive. A bag's color tells you which part of the mill it needs to meet.

Watch the next bag before making your move. The task combines recognizing its color with positioning the mill at the right moment, then preparing for the following match.

pages.title: Arkadium's Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description:
Arkadium's Bubble Shooter challenges you to clear bubbles by connecting groups of at least three in the same color. Aim a shot toward a matching cluster and use the side walls to bounce into places a direct shot cannot reach. Popping groups increases your score.

Lightning bubbles add another option: bursting one can clear a whole row. Keep track of the bubbles you have left and decide whether to take a straightforward match or aim for a more useful effect. Careful shots help open the formation while making the available bubbles count.

pages.title: Mahjong African Dream
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description:
Mahjong African Dream offers sixteen African-themed tile layouts to clear. Select matching pairs of free tiles and remove them from the board, working through the arrangement as more tiles become accessible. Try to recognize the pairs quickly as you work toward clearing the layout.

If you cannot find the next move, ask for a hint or shuffle the board. Check the available tiles before removing a pair, especially when another match may open a useful section of the layout. Continue until the board is cleared, then try a different arrangement from the collection.

pages.title: Klotski
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description:
Klotski is a sliding-block puzzle about getting a designated piece to the exit. Move the surrounding blocks to create enough room, then guide the target toward its destination. Tiles slide horizontally and vertically, so every move depends on the space available beside them.

Look at how one block's position affects the others before shifting it. A move away from the exit can still be useful if it opens a route for the target piece later. Keep rearranging the layout until the designated block can reach the required location.

pages.title: Snake Want Fruits
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description:
Snake Want Fruits puts you in control of a snake looking for its next piece of fruit. Guide it with the mouse and collect the food around the play area. Every fruit makes the snake longer, changing the size of the creature you need to manage.

Keep steering toward the next pickup as the body grows. The objective is to eat as much fruit as you can while continuing to control the larger snake. Watch its position as you turn so you can line up another approach to the food.

pages.title: Maria Coronavirus Shopping
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Maria Coronavirus Shopping follows Maria as she gets ready for a shopping trip. Help with the game's preparation activities, including choosing clothing, putting items such as keys and a wallet into her bag, and equipping a mask and gloves.

The scenes also include a guided hand-washing activity with soap and water. Click or tap the indicated objects and carry out the interactions for each stage. The game turns Maria's shopping preparations into a sequence of character-and-item tasks, from getting her belongings together to completing the washing scene.

pages.title: Baseball Kissing
pages.creator: Gamer Games
pages.description:
Baseball Kissing is a timing game about a baseball player sharing a kiss with their partner during a break. Other people are nearby, so you need to keep the couple from being seen. Use the mouse or tap controls to play while watching the onlookers.

Each level gives you three chances. Choose an opening when the surrounding people are not watching, and interrupt the kiss before their attention returns to the couple. The challenge is making use of those brief private moments without losing your available chances.

pages.title: Unblock Taxi
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Unblock Taxi is a sliding-tile road puzzle. Rearrange the pieces to connect the starting road with the destination, creating a continuous route for the taxi. Use the mouse to move tiles and work out how their road sections fit together.

The board's available space limits what can move next. Look at the connections on each tile and plan which pieces need to change position before the path can be completed. Once the start and goal are joined, the taxi has a route through the layout.

pages.title: Robot Mania
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description:
Robot Mania sends you into areas occupied by hostile robots. Move through the map, use your weapons against the attackers and clear the enemies to finish the objective. The game includes a level selection, with combat goals presented as you take on each area.

Use WASD for movement and the mouse during combat. Watch for robots while navigating the environment and continue fighting until the remaining enemies have been eliminated. The objective counter helps keep the focus on the attackers still left to defeat.

pages.title: Shoot the Turtle
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Shoot the Turtle is a distance-launching game with a turtle as its projectile. Use a cannon to send the turtle flying and try to carry it as far as possible. Bombs and jetpacks add further ways to extend the trip beyond the initial launch.

Play with the mouse or touch controls. Consider the cannon launch together with the extra equipment available during the attempt, aiming to keep the turtle traveling farther. Each flight gives you another distance to try to improve.

pages.title: Australian Hero Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description:
Australian Hero Match 3 asks you to make groups of at least three blocks in the same color. Build matches to increase your score while keeping an eye on the meter at the left side of the screen. If that meter falls too far, the game ends.

Use the mouse or tap controls to make your selections. Look for another matching group as you finish the current one, keeping the score objective and the remaining meter in view. Continued matching is the focus of each attempt.

pages.title: Real Estate Tycoon
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Real Estate Tycoon is a property-trading game in which house prices rise and fall. Click a property to buy it, then choose when to sell as its value changes. A profitable sale increases the balance you can put toward the next purchase, while poor timing can leave you selling at a loss.

Watch the displayed prices and your available money before making a trade. Different modes set balance and time objectives, giving you different conditions under which to grow your funds. The buying and selling indicators help distinguish the properties you can purchase from those you already own and can sell.

pages.title: Soccer Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Soccer Simulator lets you control a football team against the computer or watch a match between two computer-controlled teams. Move the active player, pass to keep the ball traveling through your side and shoot when you have a chance to score.

Use WASD to move, X or Space to shoot, and Z or E to pass. Tab or Escape pauses the match. The two modes give you a choice between participating in the action and observing the simulation, with the team play centered on possession, passing and reaching the opposing goal.

pages.title: Helix Unlimited
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description:
Helix Unlimited challenges you to guide a ball down a tower while avoiding its dangerous sections. The ball can touch the colored areas, but hitting a black section is something you need to prevent. Use the mouse to control the play as you work downward.

Watch the next part of the tower before committing to the descent. Keeping the safe colors and black hazards apart in your decisions is central to making progress, with each lower section presenting another position to judge.

pages.title: Animal Buggy Racing
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description:
Animal Buggy Racing combines buggy races with jumping and selectable skills. Guide your animal racer through the competition, improve its speed and choose skills that help it work toward a win. The race gives you both movement challenges and decisions about which ability to use.

Press Space or click the left mouse button to jump, and use the mouse to interact with the skill controls. Watch the route as you approach the next jump, then combine your driving progress with the upgrades and abilities you have selected.

pages.title: Ninja Turtles Coloring Book
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Ninja Turtles Coloring Book offers eight pictures to paint with a palette of twenty-three colors. Choose a drawing, select the colors you want and fill the image using the mouse or touch controls. You can save the colored picture when it is finished.

The game also links faster coloring with a better score. Decide how you want to color the scene, then work through its areas while watching your pace. The picture selection lets you move on to another drawing and try a different combination of colors.

pages.title: Fire Bird
pages.creator: Tasty Cherry
pages.description:
Fire Bird is a flying obstacle game where you try to carry a bird as far as possible without hitting a pipe. Start with a screen click or the Space bar, then keep the flight going while judging the obstacles ahead.

Distance and score give you a result to improve on the next attempt. Watch the openings between the pipes as you approach them and keep the bird on a clear route. A collision ends the opportunity to push that flight farther.

pages.title: Monster 4x4 Offroad Jeep Stunt Racing 2019
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description:
Monster 4x4 Offroad Jeep Stunt Racing 2019 takes its driving challenges onto mountain tracks and rough off-road routes. Steer a four-wheel-drive or six-wheel-drive jeep across the terrain, handling climbs and stunt sections as you work through the course.

Use WASD to move the vehicle. Watch the shape of the road before approaching a slope or obstacle, then adjust your line to keep the jeep heading along the track. The challenge centers on controlling these larger off-road vehicles through the mountain setting.

pages.title: Get 10+
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Get 10+ is a number-connecting puzzle about turning matching neighbors into higher values. Find adjacent numbers that are the same and combine them, then use the result to work toward 10 and beyond. Each larger number changes the matches you can make around it.

The challenge increases as you create higher values. Consider which matching group to combine before choosing, keeping an eye on the numbers that will remain beside the result. The aim is to keep developing the board and reach the highest number you can.

pages.title: Magic Nail Spa
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Magic Nail Spa lets you create a manicure by choosing a hand and designing its nails. Select nail shapes, apply polish and use decorations to put together a finished set. The mouse controls the selections and painting activities.

Work on individual nails or use the copy-design option to repeat a look across the hand. Rings provide an additional accessory choice for the finished design. Experiment with the available colors and decorations, then compare how the different nails and accessories work together as one manicure.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Superthief
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Hidden Objects Superthief follows Mrs. Smith as she searches a wealthy city for objects requested by her clients. Explore scenes such as mansions, museums and workshops, then tap the hidden items you have been asked to find. Faster searching earns a better score, while hints can help locate a difficult object.

Earn reputation stars to open new scenes and improve your mastery of places you already know. Layouts and difficulty change as you replay and develop your skills, so the search is more than memorizing one fixed picture. Side jobs, special equipment and mastery rewards add further goals alongside completing each client's list.

pages.title: Hospital Doctor
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Hospital Doctor is a character-care game with several patients and guided treatment activities. Use the mouse to select tools and carry out the tasks shown in each scene. Activities include checking a character's temperature, placing plasters and arranging pieces in a bone puzzle.

Different patients lead to different interactions, with prompts helping you choose the next tool or object. Follow the game's sequence and complete the care tasks before returning to the patient map. The focus is on using the supplied items within these illustrated hospital scenes.

pages.title: EG Mummy Candies
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description:
EG Mummy Candies is a collecting game where a mummy uses a swinging hook to retrieve sweets. Time a click or tap to send the hook toward candy or a lollipop, then bring the catch back. Explosive pumpkins are hazards to avoid when choosing what to grab.

The level displays a target score and a timer, giving each collection attempt a purpose beyond a single catch. Use the shop to improve your chances as you continue. Watch the hook's direction before sending it out so it heads toward a useful sweet instead of a pumpkin.

pages.title: Broken Heart
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Broken Heart is a control-and-avoidance game in which a heart must stay clear of an electric wire. Click or tap the screen to control its movement, keeping it from touching the wire. Contact breaks the heart and ends the attempt.

Watch the space between the heart and the wire as you move. Small adjustments matter when the clearance is narrow, so judge the next input against the heart's current position. The challenge is keeping it intact for as long as you can.

pages.title: Stone Merge
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description:
Stone Merge is a number puzzle played with colored rocks. Drag a rock onto another with the same number and color to combine them. The resulting rock has a higher value and a different color, creating another piece you can use in a later merge.

You can also move a rock to another available position when the board allows it. Look for matching pairs and consider where the combined piece will be left before making your move. Keep organizing and merging the rocks to build larger numbers.

pages.title: Jelly Match 3
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Jelly Match 3 is a colorful matching puzzle with a sequence of level objectives. Use the mouse to arrange matching jellies into groups of three, clearing pieces and working toward the target shown for the current board. Goals include earning score and collecting specified items.

Levels can place limits on moves or time, so check the objective and the remaining allowance before choosing the next match. Power-ups provide additional ways to clear troublesome pieces or affect the board. Work through the matching challenges and complete their requirements to continue along the level map.

pages.title: EG Pois Planets
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description:
EG Pois Planets sends an astronaut dog through a galaxy of dangerous planets and collectible stars. Click or tap to move the dog away from toxic planets while steering it into stars to earn points. The two types of objects call for opposite decisions as they approach.

The game becomes faster as the attempt continues. Look ahead for the next planet while choosing which stars to pursue, and keep adjusting your movement to preserve a clear route. Surviving the increasing pace lets you continue building the score.

pages.title: Galaxy Fleet Time Travel
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description:
Galaxy Fleet Time Travel is a space-combat adventure about piloting a ship through enemy encounters. Maneuver around attacks, fight hostile craft and face bosses as you travel through the galaxies. Collect gold coins and space energy to work toward additional characters.

The game includes equipment, skills and pickups that change what your ship can do. Different difficulty choices offer further challenges as the enemies become stronger. Develop your setup and keep collecting resources while progressing through the space missions, using the rewards to expand the characters and equipment available for later adventures.

pages.title: Saws
pages.creator: T
pages.description:
Saws is a survival game about keeping a bouncing character away from circular saw blades. The character rebounds automatically, while a click or tap sends it quickly downward. Use that fast drop to change the timing of the next landing and bounce.

Your score grows while the attempt continues. Watch the blades and judge when a faster descent will help you avoid one, rather than tapping on every bounce. Touching a saw ends the run, so each input needs to keep the character clear of the next hazard.

pages.title: Boat Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Boat Jigsaw offers ten boat pictures to rebuild as puzzles. Start with the first image and assemble its pieces, earning in-game money when you complete it. Use those earnings to purchase more pictures from the collection.

Each picture has three difficulty modes, with the hardest mode awarding more puzzle money. Choose the challenge you want to tackle, fit the pieces together and put the reward toward another image. The picture unlocks give you a progression goal alongside completing the individual jigsaws.

pages.title: Thirty One
pages.creator: Roman Parada
pages.description:
Thirty One is a card game about improving a three-card hand toward a total of 31. Cards in the same suit contribute to your strongest suit total, so an exchange needs to improve the hand as a whole rather than simply replace a low card with a high one.

Trade a card with the face-up cards on the table, or use the option to exchange the full hand. You can also pass when you want to keep what you hold. Computer opponents make their own exchanges, giving you a changing set of available cards to consider during the round.

pages.title: Blondie Perfect Day
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Blondie Perfect Day follows Princess Rachel as she prepares for her wedding. Help choose her makeup, then find a wedding dress that works with the finished look. The styling activities focus on getting the bride ready for her big day.

Compare the available cosmetic and clothing choices as you put the look together. The dress and makeup form the two main parts of the preparation, giving you a chance to coordinate Rachel's appearance before she heads to the celebration.

pages.title: Combat Strike Multiplayer
pages.creator: AngryGamez
pages.description:
Combat Strike Multiplayer is a team shooting game with soldiers divided into blue and red sides. Join the fighting across combat maps and use your weapons against the opposing team. The arenas take inspiration from familiar tactical-shooter settings, with the conflict organized around the two teams.

Use WASD to move and the number keys 1 and 2 to select weapons. T opens chat and Tab brings up the menu. Keep track of your team while navigating the map, and use the weapon selection to prepare for the next encounter with an opponent.

pages.title: Hamster assistant
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description:
Hamster assistant is a physics puzzle about removing panels to collect golden stars and fruit. Click a panel to take it out of the scene, changing the arrangement of supports and the movement of the objects around it. Work out which removals will bring the collectibles within reach.

The game contains fifteen levels, with new layouts to solve as you progress. Consider how a piece will move when its support disappears before clearing the next panel. The order of your choices matters because each removal changes what the remaining objects can do.

pages.title: Panda love
pages.creator: Julio Cesar Fuente Saugar
pages.description: Panda love is a pixel-art platform game about a panda setting out to rescue his girlfriend. Make your way through twenty levels, tackling a more difficult course as the adventure progresses. Completing the platforming stages carries the panda closer to the end of the rescue journey.

pages.title: One+Two+Three
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: One+Two+Three is a quick-calculation game in which every equation has an answer of 1, 2 or 3. Work out the expression and choose the correct result from those three options. The challenge is answering accurately while keeping up your pace across successive calculations.

pages.title: FGP Plumber Game
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
FGP Plumber Game is a pipe-rotation puzzle about carrying water across the board. Turn the pipe sections until their openings connect, forming a continuous route to the other side. Every section along the intended path needs to face the right way.

Choose Level mode to work through the puzzles or Timed mode for a clock-based challenge. Look at the starting point and destination before rotating the middle sections, then check the joins for any break in the route. Completing the connection gives the water a way through.

pages.title: Braided Hair Salon
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Braided Hair Salon asks you to style a girl's hair before her first date. Take the hairdresser's role and recreate the braided looks presented by the game, working through the styling activities to produce the finished hairstyle. The date preparations give you a reason to try the different braid designs.

pages.title: Greyhound Racing
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description:
Greyhound Racing is a betting simulation in which you choose dogs before watching a race unfold. Review the greyhounds and their displayed odds, select your wager and start the race to see the result. The betting screen shows your stake and the balance you have available.

You can clear a bet before starting if you want to change your selection. Follow the race and compare the finishing result with the wager you placed, then decide how to use your remaining in-game balance for another attempt. The action centers on choosing bets and watching the dogs race.

pages.title: Princess Room Face Painting
pages.creator: Next Vision Solutions
pages.description:
Princess Room Face Painting brings princesses together for a face-painting party during the holidays. Choose colors and paint designs for the characters, then add accessories to complete their party looks. Your selections shape the decoration on each princess's face.

Compare the available colors with the accessories you want to use, and build a look around the painting you have chosen. The game focuses on coordinating face decoration and finishing details as the princesses get ready for their shared celebration.

pages.title: Elsie Dream Dress
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description:
Elsie Dream Dress lets you design a dress for Elsie by combining a skirt with a matching top. Choose the two main pieces, then add a decorative waistband if it suits the outfit. The dress takes shape through the clothing choices you put together.

Complete Elsie's appearance with a purse, shoes and a hairstyle. Look at those accessories alongside the dress so the finished look works as one outfit. The game gives you both the dress-building stage and the final styling choices around it, letting you shape more than a single garment.

pages.title: Princess Wedding Cake
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Princess Wedding Cake asks you to help Elisa finish a cake for her sister's wedding. Most of the baking is already done, and Jack has tasted a piece. Your part is to decorate the last cake so it is ready for the celebration.

Choose from the decoration options and build the finished appearance of the cake. Focus on how the details work together as you complete Elisa's remaining wedding preparation, turning the prepared cake into the display you want to present.

pages.title: Princess Wonderful Day!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Princess Wonderful Day! is a makeover game about preparing a princess for a wedding in a castle ballroom. Help her choose makeup for the occasion, then select the dress she will wear to the event. The two choices come together in her completed look.

Compare the outfit with the cosmetics you have selected and try combinations that suit the celebration. Your task is to resolve the princess's styling decisions so she is ready to attend the ballroom wedding.
